text:
The deed gives the friend a fee simple subject to an executory limitation, with a shifting executory interest in the sister's children who reach 25; that contingent class interest is saved from the Rule Against Perpetuities because any child born during the sister's lifetime must reach 25, if at all, within 21 years of her death. Title is therefore in the friend, the son, the daughter, and any additional children of the sister born during her lifetime.  
CONFIDENCE: 95
